issues.main_description_html:
Refactor Class-based Interceptors to Functional Pattern

  • Rewrite data-api.interceptor.ts as an HttpInterceptorFn.
  • Provide interceptor in app.config.ts using provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([...])).

QA Tester Summary - Issue #399: Implement Functional Interceptors

Suite: qa_testing/tests/e2e/interceptors/issue_399_functional_interceptors.spec.js (Playwright - Chromium - headed)
Env: Dev real site https://dev-gallery.villume.com/XQKmuW7W - viewer/public gallery real data

Test Scenario & Result

# Box Scenario Given -> Expected Matrix Result
1 White Functional interceptor source and provider wiring data-api.interceptor.ts + app.config.ts -> HttpInterceptorFn exported and registered with provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([ dataApiInterceptor ]), withFetch()) TP Pass
2 Gray Real gallery loads through interceptor-backed HTTP calls Valid share string XQKmuW7W -> gallery title/body renders and API responses return success TP Pass
3 Black Invalid share string is handled safely Invalid share string -> app redirects/handles forbidden access with no captured 5xx response TN Pass
4 Task Sprint #399 acceptance Class-based interceptor refactor and app config provider pattern are present TP + TN Pass

Code Review Summary

  • src/app/shared/http-interceptor/data-api.interceptor.ts already uses HttpInterceptorFn, HttpHandlerFn, and exports dataApiInterceptor.
  • No class-based implements HttpInterceptor pattern remains in the interceptor file.
  • src/app/app.config.ts imports provideHttpClient and withInterceptors, then registers dataApiInterceptor in the application providers.
  • Existing interceptor behavior is preserved: it adds accept: application/json, skips progress requests, and decrypts data.cry responses before returning a cloned HttpResponse.

QA Tester Summary - Issue #405: Double Check Get Viewer Gallery

Suite: qa_testing/tests/e2e/redis-viewer/issue_405_double_check_get_viewer_gallery.spec.js (Playwright - Chromium - headed)
Env: Dev real site https://dev-gallery.villume.com/XQKmuW7W - viewer/public gallery real data with Access-Code header

Test Scenario & Result

# Box Scenario Given -> Expected Matrix Result
1 White Redis viewer cache keys and fallback are wired api-modules/get-viewer-json.ts + Redis client -> reads viewer:{share}:path, viewer:{share}:json, viewer:{share}:version, and falls back to backend when Redis/path is unavailable TP Pass
2 Gray Repeated real viewer-gallery fetch stays successful Valid share string XQKmuW7W -> two consecutive GET /api/get-viewer-json/XQKmuW7W calls return 200, same share string, and gallery renders TP Pass
3 Black Invalid viewer-gallery share is handled without server error Invalid share string -> server route returns structured 409 CONFLICT / Data not found, page redirects to safe not-found flow TN Pass
4 Task Sprint #405 checkbox Check Redis Redis-backed viewer-gallery code path, Redis miss/error fallback, and real dev gallery response are verified TP + TN Pass

Code Review Summary

  • api-modules/globals/redis-client.ts creates a Redis client from redisConfig and connects before viewer JSON lookup.
  • api-modules/get-viewer-json.ts checks Redis key viewer:{shareString}:path to decide whether local viewer.json should be read/created.
  • When Redis has viewer JSON data, viewer:{shareString}:json is decoded, gallery_version is refreshed, and transient Redis keys viewer:{shareString}:version / viewer:{shareString}:json are cleared outside localhost.
  • When Redis path/data is missing or Redis lookup throws, the route falls back to environment.baseURL_go/v1/viewers/json/{shareString} instead of failing the viewer.
  • src/app/shared/services/main.service.ts stores the server-side viewer response in TransferState, so the browser can consume SSR data without requiring an extra client fetch.
